```{r, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
library(brms)
library(tidyverse)
library(rticulate)
library(rcartocolor)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggpmisc)
library(modelbased)
```

## A single participant - smooth Y signal for them
```{r} 
en00_tongue <- dlc_tongue |>
  filter(client  == "en01")
en00_tongue_up <- dlc_tongue_up |>
  filter(client == "en01")
```

### Before resampling -- only visualisation
```{r} 
en00_tongue |> select(time_annot, Y, Y_sm)

en00_tongue |> 
  filter(knot == "10") |> 
  ggplot(aes(time_annot, Y, group = date_time)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.05) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Y_sm), alpha = 0.05, colour = "purple")

set.seed(13579)
kdi <- sample(unique(en00_tongue$displ_id), 9)

c <- unlist(distinct(en09_tongue |> filter(displ_id %in% kdi) |> select(word)), use.names = F)
c <- paste(c,(sort(kdi) %% 15)-4)
names(c) <- as.character(sort(kdi))
en00_tongue |> 
  filter(displ_id %in% kdi) |> 
  ggplot(aes(time_annot, Y)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(y = Y_sm), colour = "red") +
  facet_wrap(vars(displ_id), scales = "free", labeller = as_labeller(c))

```

## After resampling -- only visualisation
```{r}
en00_tongue_up |> 
  filter(knot == 5) |> 
  ggplot(aes(time_int, Y_sm_up, group = displ_id)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.05, color = "palegreen") +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.05, color = "palegreen")

en00_tongue_up |> 
  filter(knot == 5, displ_id == 9) |> 
  ggplot(aes(time_int, Y_sm_up_sm, group = displ_id)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.25) +
    geom_line()
```

## Kinematics
### Check knot trajectories for a given pair of words by a given speaker
```{r}
word_lookup <- function(speaker,word1,rep=1) {
  a <- dlc_tongue_up |>
    filter(client == speaker)
  a |>
    group_by(date_time) |>
    filter(word == word1) |>
    summarise(min = min(displ_id), max = max(displ_id)) |>
    slice(rep) -> b
  a |>
    filter(displ_id > unlist(b["min"]-1) & displ_id < unlist(b["max"]+1)) |>
    ggplot(aes(time_int, Y_sm_up_sm)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
      facet_grid(rows = vars(displ_id), scales = "free_y")
}
petition <- word_lookup("en10","aggadic",2)
patrician <- word_lookup("en10","agraphic",2)
ggarrange(petition,patrician,ncol=2)
```

### Mark onset and offset based on annotation for a given word
```{r}
show_where_to_get_landmarks <- function(speaker, word1, rep = 1, knot1 = 10) {
  a <- dlc_tongue_up |>
    filter(client == speaker)
  min1 <- a |> 
      filter(word == word1) |>
      select(start_of_vowel_within_annot_1) |>
      distinct() |>
      slice(rep) |>
      unlist()
  max1 <- a |> 
      filter(word == word1) |>
      select(end_of_vowel_within_annot_1) |>
      distinct() |>
      slice(rep) |>
      unlist()
  min2 <- a |> 
      filter(word == word1) |>
      select(start_of_vowel_within_annot_2) |>
      distinct() |>
      slice(rep) |>
      unlist()
  max2 <- a |> 
      filter(word == word1) |>
      select(end_of_vowel_within_annot_2) |>
      distinct() |>
      slice(rep) |>
      unlist()
  id1 <- a |> 
      filter(word == word1 & knot == knot1) |>
      select(displ_id) |>
      distinct() |>
      slice(rep) |>
      unlist()
  # get_min1(word, rep) -> min1
  # get_max1(word, rep) -> max1
  # get_id(word, rep, knot) -> id1
  # get_min2(word, rep) -> min2
  # get_max2(word, rep) -> max2
  a |>
    filter(displ_id == id1) |> 
    ggplot(aes(time_int, Y_sm_up_vel)) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_line(aes(y = abs(Y_sm_up_vel)), colour = "red") +
      ylim(-1,1) +
      labs(title = id1) +
      annotate("rect", xmin = min1, xmax = max1, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.3) +
      annotate("rect", xmin = min2, xmax = max2, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.3) -> velocity
  a |>
    filter(displ_id == id1) |>
    ggplot(aes(time_int, Y_sm_up_sm)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
      labs(title = id1) +
      annotate("rect", xmin = min1, xmax = max1, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.3) +
      annotate("text", x = min1, y = 0, label = as.character(round(min1,2))) +
      annotate("text", x = max1, y = 0, label = as.character(round(max1,2))) +
      annotate("rect", xmin = min2, xmax = max2, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.3) +
      annotate("text", x = min2, y = 0, label = as.character(round(min2,2))) +
      annotate("text", x = max2, y = 0, label = as.character(round(max2,2))) -> displacement
  ggarrange(displacement,velocity,nrow = 2)
}
show_where_to_get_landmarks("en10","aggadic",2)
```


### Get landmarks for a single recording
```{r}
# Filter signal to include a reduced time window
reduce_window <- function(word, rep = 1, knot = 10) {
  get_min1(word, rep) -> min1
  get_max1(word, rep) -> max1
  get_id(word, rep, knot) -> id1
  en09_tongue_up |>
    filter(displ_id == id1, time_int > min1, time_int < max1)
}
specify_landmarks_time <- function(word, rep = 1) {
  get_min1(word, rep) -> min1
  get_max1(word, rep) -> max1
  get_landmarks(en09_up_win$Y_sm_up_vel, en09_up_win$time_int, min1, max1)
}

en09_up_win <- reduce_window("attraction",1)
en09_up_win_land <- specify_landmarks_time("attraction",1)

en09_up_win_land_long <- en09_up_win_land |> 
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "land")

en09_up_win_land_long

en09_up_win |> 
  ggplot(aes(time_int, abs(get_velocity(Y_sm_up_sm)))) +
  geom_point(colour = "red") +
  geom_vline(data = en09_up_win_land_long |> filter(str_detect(land, "_ons|_off")), aes(xintercept = value)) +
  labs(y = "Absolute velocity")

en09_up_win |> 
  ggplot(aes(time_int, Y_sm_up_sm)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(data = en09_up_win_land_long |> filter(str_detect(land, "_ons|_off")), aes(xintercept = value)) +
  labs(y = "Y displacement")
```

### Get landmarks for all recordings of a given participant
#### first a few functions that make displ_id identification easier
```{r}
landmarks_segmentinfo <- function(lands, tongue_up) {left_join(lands, dlc_tongue_up |> select(displ_id_client,word,client,date_time,file,displ_id,start1_round,end1_round,start2_round,end2_round) |> distinct(), by = join_by(displ_id_client)) |> 
  relocate(c(word,file,start1_round,end1_round,start2_round,end2_round), .after = displ_id_client) |>
  left_join(y = word_segments, by = join_by(word)) |>
  relocate(stress, .after = word) |>
  arrange(group,stress,V2,poa_C2,voice_C2,R,word)
  }

poa_na_summary <- function(landmarks_segmentinfo,var1,var2) {
  landmarks_segmentinfo |>
  group_by({{var1}}, {{var2}}) |>
  summarise("_time|_vel|_on|_off",~sum(is.na(.)))
}

en00_tongue_up |>
  select(file,word,start1_round,end1_round,start2_round,end2_round) |>
  distinct() |>
  count(end2_round)
```

#### Extract landmarks and check how many was successful
```{r}
en09_up_lands <- en09_tongue_up |> 
    filter(knot == 10, time_int > start_of_vowel_within_annot_1+0.03, 
           time_int < end_of_vowel_within_annot_1-0.03) |> 
    reframe(
      get_landmarks(Y_sm_up_vel, time_int, start_of_vowel_within_annot_1+0.03, end_of_vowel_within_annot_1-0.03),
      .by = displ_id_client
    )

en09_up_lands_segmentinfo <- landmarks_segmentinfo(en09_up_lands, en09_tongue_up)
poa_na_summary(en09_up_lands_segmentinfo)[c(1,2,11:20)]
poa_na_summary_stress(en09_up_lands_segmentinfo)
```

### Visualise landmarks for a sample of recordings
```{r}
en09_up_lands_long <- en09_up_lands_segmentinfo |> 
  pivot_longer(5:22, names_to = "land") |>
  relocate(c(land,value), .after = displ_id)

sample_displ_id <- sample(en09_up_lands |> drop_na() |> left_join(en09_up_lands_segmentinfo |> select(displ_id,poa_C2)) |> filter(poa_C2 != "bilabial") |> select(displ_id) |> unlist(),9)

en09_tongue_up |> 
  filter(displ_id %in% sample_displ_id) |> 
  ggplot(aes(time_int, Y_sm_up_sm)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_vline(data = en09_up_lands_long |> 
                   filter(displ_id %in% sample_displ_id) |> filter(str_detect(land, "_ons|_off")), aes(xintercept = value)) +
    geom_vline(data = en09_up_lands_long |> 
                  filter(displ_id %in% sample_displ_id) |> filter(str_detect(land, "_round")), aes(xintercept = value), colour = "red") +
    xlim(0, 0.75) +
    facet_wrap(vars(word,displ_id), scales = "free_y") +
    guides(colour = "none")
```

### Get landmarks again with slightly modified boundaries 
```{r}
en09_up_lands_second <- en09_up_lands_segmentinfo |>
  filter(is.na(max_disp_time)) |>
  select(displ_id) |>
  left_join(y = en09_tongue_up, by = join_by(displ_id)) |>
  filter(time_int > start_of_vowel_within_annot_1-0.02, 
         time_int < end_of_vowel_within_annot_1 + 0.05) |> 
  reframe(
    get_landmarks(Y_sm_up_vel, time_int, start_of_vowel_within_annot_1-0.02, end_of_vowel_within_annot_1+0.05),
    .by = displ_id
  ) |>
  arrange(displ_id)

en09_up_lands_second_segmentinfo <- landmarks_segmentinfo(en09_up_lands_second)
poa_na_summary(en09_up_lands_second_segmentinfo)
```
```{r}
en09_up_lands_second_long <- en09_up_lands_second_segmentinfo |> 
  pivot_longer(5:20, names_to = "land") |>
  relocate(c(land,value), .after = displ_id)

non_bilabial_second <- en09_up_lands_second |> drop_na(matches("_time|_vel")) |> left_join(en09_up_lands_second_segmentinfo |> select(displ_id,poa_C2)) |> filter(poa_C2 != "bilabial")
sample_displ_id_second <- sample(non_bilabial_second |> select(displ_id),if (nrow(non_bilabial_second) < 9) {nrow(non_bilabial_second)} else {9})

en09_tongue_up |> 
  filter(displ_id %in% sample_displ_id_second) |> 
  ggplot(aes(time_int, Y_sm_up_sm)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_vline(data = en09_up_lands_second_long |> 
                   filter(displ_id %in% sample_displ_id_second) |> filter(str_detect(land, "_ons|_off")), aes(xintercept = value)) +
    geom_vline(data = en09_up_lands_second_long |> 
                   filter(displ_id %in% sample_displ_id_second) |> filter(str_detect(land, "_round")), aes(xintercept = value), colour = "red") +
    #ylim(-1, 1) +
    facet_wrap(vars(word), scales = "free_y") +
    guides(colour = "none")
```
